usd_reason: The dollar had its worst week in over 3 months amid Fed doubts
gold_reason: Lower US Treasury yields and plunging oil prices could boost gold prices
indices_reason: The market is waiting for more clarity on interest rates and inflation
lead_story: The US dollar had a weak week due to doubts about the Fed's ability to raise interest rates, oil prices are plunging on hopes of de-escalation with Iran, and the US Treasury yields are falling, all of which are impacting the market. The Fed is considering rate hikes to address inflation. The joint action on the yen by Tokyo and Washington is also being closely watched.
